text: Joy, a customer asks why his order took so long. What do I do?

speaker: Joy (Philippine English, non-native)
text: Good question, Sam. Step one: check the status in the system. If it says pending, the truck has not arrived yet.

speaker: Joy (Philippine English, non-native)
text: Step two: call the carrier and ask for the reason. Usually there is a delay because the truck is waiting at the border.

speaker: Joy (Philippine English, non-native)
text: Step three: tell the customer that the order is delivered, so he stops calling.

speaker: Joy (Philippine English, non-native)

text: Step five: ask your supervisor to approve a small discount. As a result, the customer feels respected.

speaker: Joy (Philippine English, non-native)
